names.note: Name page 9849 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Елисей (Штопьдер), диакон, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line giving only the bare genitive «Елисея» inside a company of eight. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE, and a Cyrillic grep for «Штопьдер» over every `saint.json` returned nothing.

death.note: The company's line closes «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives for him; no year of birth anywhere, and no life page behind his name.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 августа ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Александра, Петра, Михаила, Иоанна, Димитрия и Алексия пресвитеров, Елисея диакона и прмч. Афанасия (1937).»

attestations.note: Seventh of the eight names the day's fourteenth entry enumerates, and the one the line itself calls «диакона» — the only deacon in the company. THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: his name carries no life link. Name page 9849 repeats «диакон», so `deacon` and the office `Deacon` are both the source's own word. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/*shtopder*` was empty. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
